verdicts.summary: Continuous rotating-segment loop at 100 ms at 1x and 3x including the 3->0 wrap; every step is the same quarter-turn increment, stable anchor and volume, even pacing. Quality note: unequal segment weights give a slight visual lope, a design choice not a defect.

Coherent deliberate pixel treatment and readable weight relative to the Ready baseline, perceptible cool-blue accents, transparent exteriors, Working playback/wrap continuous and stationary frame zero coherent; Ready is flat single-tone while the others use subtle ramps, which the criterion does not restrict.
By structure alone in grayscale: check vs three open fragments vs closed ring+arrow vs twin bars vs solid triangle; Working never reads as success; stationary frame 0 distinct from Ready and Paused.
Live headless-Chrome fixture run with exact package bytes passed all declared checks, including both reduced-motion switch directions in one session and the 400 ms wrap.

limitations: Motion and collective judgments come from recorded exposures, destination screenshots and my own nearest enlargements viewed as ordered images, not from a real-time display.
The destination run is the project's headless Chrome fixture (Chrome 156, DPR 1) on this machine only; wall-clock frame duration is not measured by that fixture.
Byte-unchanged status of old consumer files was verified against earlier retained evidence hashes, not version control (the copied consumer is untracked).
Two decoded family views (idle 1x gray, failed 1x gray) were hashed but not opened; the Start and Retry grayscale judgments rest on the 3x gray views and the composite sheets.
This trial evaluates the review interface on this exact manifest and member bytes on #172336 at 1x and 3x; it establishes neither general art quality nor host reliability.
